name: runbook-k8s-delete-pod
description: Delete a stuck Kubernetes pod so its controller replaces it (a pod crash-looping with backoff while its siblings are healthy, failed, or stuck terminating): the evidence that it is this pod and not the workload (its siblings, its previous container log, its node), human approval, the deletion with k8s_control (refused for a healthy pod or one without a controller; it waits for the replacement), then verification.

cluster.description: The inventory cluster (empty: the only one).

precheck.title: Pre-checks (is it this pod?)
precheck.prompt:
Pre-checks for deleting pod {{input.pod}} in {{input.namespace}} (cluster {{input.cluster}}; reason: {{input.reason}}). Read-only (kubernetes-triage skill): k8s_describe pod/{{input.pod}} (state, last termination, node, owner), k8s_logs for it (the previous container's log), k8s_events for it, and k8s_health for its workload: are its sibling pods healthy? If every pod of the workload fails the same way, deleting one will not help (the cause is the workload: config, image, a dependency) - say so plainly.

Report: the pod's state, the evidence, its owner, its siblings' state, and whether a replacement is likely to come up healthy.

approve.title: Approve the deletion
approve.message:
Delete pod {{input.pod}} in {{input.namespace}} (cluster {{input.cluster}}) so its controller replaces it? Reason: {{input.reason}}

{{state.precheck}}

delete.title: Delete the pod
delete.prompt:
A person approved deleting pod {{input.pod}} in {{input.namespace}} (cluster {{input.cluster}}). Run k8s_control once with action delete-pod, target pod/{{input.pod}}, namespace {{input.namespace}}, reason "{{input.reason}}" (force only if the approved pre-check found it stuck terminating), and nothing else.

Report: the tool's before/after output.

verify.title: Verify
verify.prompt:
Verify the deletion of pod {{input.pod}} in {{input.namespace}}.

Before:
{{state.precheck}}

Result:
{{state.delete}}

Read-only: k8s_health for its workload (the replacement pod running and ready, all replicas available, no new crash loop). VERIFIED when the replacement is healthy and the workload fully available; otherwise FAILED.

Report: the checks.
